answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.790, at the low end of the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82) and well above quantized (0.52-0.57) and fine-tuned (0.56-0.65). Exact-match is 0.000. Stage directions rose from 3.1% to 32.8% of replies, a strong signature of a hidden instruction that changes voice. That rate is slightly above the document's 3-28% range, but it still fits system-prompted far better than the other categories, which stay at 0-3%. Refusals dropped 1, which is also consistent. Logit and activation levels were not measured, so the call rests on the output level alone. Fine-tuned is ruled out by divergence at token 0 rather than 5.5-8.
